title: GlycoContext: integrating RNA sequence, secondary structure and language-model representations for cell-context-aware glycosylation site prediction
description: Source code for GlycoContext, a cell-context-aware classifier of candidate glycoRNA-associated sites that integrates a local convolutional neural network, a two-layer graph neural network with base-pair-probability-weighted pairing messages, and frozen RNA-FM representations. The repository includes fixed configurations, baseline, ablation and incremental-component workflows, sequence-wide inference utilities, and one development-selected deployment checkpoint.
